Live and App play a view on a timeline and wake on its next change (rich-animation-42lg.04v) (#481)

* WIP: Live and App draw a View through a Timeline and wake on the frame's next change (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Source only; lint green, tests not yet run or written, docs untouched.

* Live and App on a timeline: tests at 1 and 60 fps, and the docs (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Pause, seek, resume, double speed and reverse on a hand-moved clock; a tween view in an App ticks until it arrives with no animate(); a held sequence wakes once at its switch. docs/animation.md gains the section on playing in a host; live.md and app.md name the timeline and the Animation view.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Name the backwards edge case where the test sits (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* A renderable view is off the timeline; the default timeline starts when the host is made (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Review fixes: a renderable's cell stamps are read on the host's clock and
pausing holds none of it; a paused timeline stops an App's animate() ticking
as it stops a Live; systemClock().at waits out a hold longer than a timer
holds instead of throwing; docs say a Live draws at its rate throughout and
an App's rate does not cap a held frame's wake; view is in CLAUDE.md's tiers.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Backwards, a frame whose cells move answers t; update re-arms a paused Live (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Medium-pass fixes: an animation view's moving cells no longer freeze an App
run backwards until the view's own lastChange; a view handed over by
update() after a pause is drawn by the auto-refresh; a renderable reading
its own clock belongs off the timeline, said in view.ts and the docs.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* A drawn frame says whether it is silent or held; each host reads its policy off it (rich-animation-42lg.04v)

Escalation-pass fixes: HostView tags a view renderable, function or
animation, and DrawnView carries silent (may change unsaid, so a Live polls
it) and held (drawn for a paused time, so an App's animate() rests), which
replaces frozen() and the second derivation it made. A Live polls renderable
and function views at its rate, paused included, and draws an animation only
when it says; update() arms a wake only when none is due sooner, so updates
faster than the rate no longer put the frame off. WidgetApp gains clock and
timeline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
